desc:
👋 Welcome to Cardboard's Difficulty Chart Obby! This is an obby where it starts off easy but gets increasingly harder as you progress. Each difficulty will get harder than the last. Are you good enough to reach the end?

🚩 There are currently 280 stages!

✅ All stages are proven to be possible. But only around 0.1% of players beat the game!

🎁 Earn a FREE skip every 45 minutes!

👍 Leave a like and favourite our game to support us!

🏷️ Tags (ignore): obby, wallhop, difficulty chart obby, dco, rage quit, hard, easy, troll, impossible, crashout, platformer, parkour, extreme
